label: Robert C. Koons, The Grim Reaper Kalam…: Within the stipulated Grim Placer sequence, once a Fred…
interpretation: Koons explicitly identifies persistence at the placed position throughout the remaining GP sequence as a tacit assumption of the particle argument. This records an acknowledged condition of the stipulated scenario, not a universal physical law, an independently established possibility or a proof of causal finitism. Read with the full materialized pp.18–22 context, including his vanishing-particle objection and proposed persistent-signal replacement; PGR at printed p.9 was also read as context for indexed creation and maintenance. The signal reformulation is not silently substituted for this particle-position statement. No identification with the all-code IndexedSignalReaper.Forwarding interface is made: that requires an explicit normalized-register and detector/handoff dictionary. Countable patchwork preservation and independent metaphysical applicability remain open.
